A_8_1.title: User Endpoint Devices
A_8_1.description: Protect information on and processed by user endpoint devices (laptops, phones) using an endpoint security policy.

A_8_2.title: Privileged Access Rights
A_8_2.description: Restrict and carefully manage the allocation and use of privileged access rights across all systems.

A_8_3.title: Information Access Restriction
A_8_3.description: Restrict access to information and systems to what is required for each user's role, using least privilege.

A_8_4.title: Access to Source Code
A_8_4.description: Restrict access to program source code and associated tools to authorized persons only; apply version control.

A_8_5.title: Secure Authentication
A_8_5.description: Implement secure authentication technologies and procedures including MFA for sensitive systems and all remote access.

A_8_6.title: Capacity Management
A_8_6.description: Monitor and adjust resource usage and projections to ensure required system capacity and performance.

A_8_7.title: Protection Against Malware
A_8_7.description: Implement malware protection controls (EDR, AV, code signing, email filtering) supported by appropriate user awareness.

A_8_8.title: Management of Technical Vulnerabilities
A_8_8.description: Timely identification, evaluation, and remediation of technical vulnerabilities across all systems.

A_8_9.title: Configuration Management
A_8_9.description: Establish, document, and maintain configurations (including security configurations) for hardware, software, and cloud services.

A_8_10.title: Information Deletion
A_8_10.description: Delete information when it is no longer required, in accordance with legal, contractual, and business requirements.

A_8_11.title: Data Masking
A_8_11.description: Use data masking, pseudonymization, or anonymization to protect personal data in non-production environments.

A_8_12.title: Data Leakage Prevention
A_8_12.description: Apply data leakage prevention measures to systems, networks, and endpoints that process sensitive information.

A_8_13.title: Information Backup
A_8_13.description: Make and regularly test backup copies of information, software, and system images in accordance with an agreed backup policy.

A_8_14.title: Redundancy of Information Processing Facilities
A_8_14.description: Implement sufficient redundancy in information processing facilities to meet availability requirements.

A_8_15.title: Logging
A_8_15.description: Produce, protect, and retain logs of user activities, exceptions, faults, and security events for defined retention periods.

A_8_16.title: Monitoring Activities
A_8_16.description: Monitor networks, systems, and applications to detect anomalous behaviour and potential security events.

A_8_17.title: Clock Synchronization
A_8_17.description: Synchronize clocks of all information processing systems to an approved time source to support log correlation and forensics.

A_8_18.title: Use of Privileged Utility Programs
A_8_18.description: Control and restrict the use of utility programs capable of overriding system and application controls.

A_8_19.title: Installation of Software on Operational Systems
A_8_19.description: Implement procedures to control software installation on operational systems by authorized persons only.

A_8_20.title: Networks Security
A_8_20.description: Secure networks and network devices to protect information in systems and applications.

A_8_21.title: Security of Network Services
A_8_21.description: Identify, implement, and monitor security mechanisms for network services, including cloud networking.

A_8_22.title: Segregation of Networks
A_8_22.description: Segregate groups of information services, users, and information systems within the network.

A_8_23.title: Web Filtering
A_8_23.description: Manage access to external websites to reduce exposure to malicious content.

A_8_24.title: Use of Cryptography
A_8_24.description: Define and implement a cryptography policy covering approved algorithms, key management, and encryption requirements.

A_8_25.title: Secure Development Life Cycle
A_8_25.description: Establish and apply rules for the secure development of software and systems throughout the development lifecycle.

A_8_26.title: Application Security Requirements
A_8_26.description: Identify, specify, and approve information security requirements for application development and procurement.

A_8_27.title: Secure System Architecture and Engineering Principles
A_8_27.description: Establish, document, and apply secure engineering principles for all development and system engineering activities.

A_8_28.title: Secure Coding
A_8_28.description: Apply secure coding principles to software development to prevent common vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10, injection, XSS).

A_8_29.title: Security Testing in Development and Acceptance
A_8_29.description: Define and implement security testing processes in the development lifecycle and during acceptance testing.

A_8_30.title: Outsourced Development
A_8_30.description: Supervise and monitor outsourced system development activities to ensure security requirements are met.

A_8_31.title: Separation of Development, Test and Production Environments
A_8_31.description: Separate development, testing, and production environments to reduce the risk of unauthorized access or changes to the production system.

A_8_32.title: Change Management
A_8_32.description: Manage changes to information processing facilities and systems through a formal change management process.

A_8_33.title: Test Information
A_8_33.description: Protect and manage test information; never use live production data in test environments without appropriate controls.

A_8_34.title: Protection of Information Systems During Audit Testing
A_8_34.description: Plan and agree audit requirements and activities involving verification of operational systems to minimize disruption.
